question: What is the remainder when \(7^{2024} + 7^{2025} + 7^{2026}\) is divided by \(19?\)
solution:
All three terms contain the factor \(7^{2024}\). Factoring it out gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
7^{2024}+7^{2025}+7^{2026}
&=7^{2024}(1+7+7^2)\\
&=7^{2024}(1+7+49)\\
&=7^{2024}\cdot57\\
&=19\bigl(3\cdot7^{2024}\bigr).
\end{aligned}
\]
The expression is an integer multiple of \(19\), so the remainder is \(\boxed{0}\), choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
